headerDisplay: Adds GVM BLE (Bluetooth) lights to HomeKit. Leave the device list empty to pick up the single light advertising itself as `BT_LED`, the discovered device id is then printed to the Homebridge log.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name used for this platform in the Homebridge log.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the light in HomeKit.

id.title: Device ID
id.description: Bluetooth id of the light, as printed to the log when it is discovered. Required as soon as you have more than one light.

pollInterval.title: Health check interval
pollInterval.description: How often (in milliseconds) every light is checked for being alive. A light that stopped answering is disconnected and looked for again.

timeout.title: Bluetooth timeout
timeout.description: How long (in milliseconds) a single Bluetooth operation may take before it is considered failed. Increase it if your light is far away and connecting keeps timing out.
